name: Belgium
dossier:
The Belgium national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Red Devils, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 8 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from UEFA to this expanded 48-team tournament.

A team racing against time, blending fading legends with electric new pace.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Belgium will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group G and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group G. The connection between Kevin De Bruyne and Jérémy Doku is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Kevin De Bruyne - the clinical midfield who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Belgium are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Belgium's 'golden generation' won bronze in 2018 but never the gold  -  this is the last dance for several greats.
Belgium boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Third place (2018).
